instruction:
IPC-D-356A Bare-Board Net Test Export

You have a KiCad PCB in /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb with 5 named nets (VCC, GND, SDA, SCL, RESET) and components R1, R2, C1, U1, J1.

Generate /home/user/Desktop/netlist.d356 as a valid IPC-D-356A bare-board netlist file. Every pad of every net must appear as a 317-code record.

Requirements:
1. Include header P-records declaring JOB, CODE, UNITS MM, DIM M, DATE.
2. Produce one 317 record per pad. Net name field is 14 characters (left-justified, space-padded). Coordinates in 0.01mm units (e.g. 20.0mm = +002000). Hole code A01 for through-hole pads; A00 for SMD pads.
3. Each named net must appear in >=2 records (at minimum the pads that connect to it).
4. All pad coordinates must lie within the board bounding box defined by the Edge.Cuts outline.
5. J1 through-hole pads must be coded A01 (PTH); SMD pads (R1, R2, C1, U1) must be coded A00.
6. End the file with a single line: 999

Write /home/user/Desktop/netlist.d356.
